scope: Unit validation: executes complete production vip.js plus actual app initialState/save/escaping/button helpers; DOM rendering and storage are controlled fixtures. Credit checks mutate financial state to verify VIP calculation independence, not real payment integration.

tests.name: Existing account receives VIP10 once and retains historical XP, funds and all unrelated state
Reset defaults also start at VIP10 without historic XP or financial changes
75 thresholds are finite, strictly increasing and preserve the published milestones
Additional honorXp accumulates after the legacy baseline and upgrades at the exact threshold
Large successful XP increments cross multiple levels and stop at level75
Refresh preserves upgraded level, original baseline and worn theme without remigration
Crediting gold beans or RM, and recording red-envelope/transfer changes, adds no growth
Locked themes cannot be worn, including forged direct action calls
Unlocked theme is persisted without changing balances, history or baseline
Theme save failure rolls back the entire state and retains the previous persisted selection
Entrance toggle saves on success and rolls back on storage failure
Previewing a locked theme does not unlock it, change growth or save any account state
Eligible entrance and preview stop gift effects before playing; disabled automatic entrance leaves gift effects intact
